_about: The checks each discipline's professional verifies before stamping, by topic: [check, basis (code or standard), method or formula]. review_disc.py puts them in the discipline's review pack; a check shows 'awaiting design' until the discipline's design script reports it (package checks with the same name). Uganda law and standards first; British / European standards where Uganda adopts them or is silent.

Building regulations (Building Control A: Habitable rooms: minimum floor area and width
each habitable room ≥ 7.5 m², bedrooms ≥ 2.4 m wide; rooms from the room schedule
habitable rooms ≥ 2.6 m clear; measured from the levels and ceilings
glazed area ≥ 10% of floor area; openable area ≥ 5% of floor area, per room
rise ≤ 190 mm, going ≥ 250 mm, 2R + G between 550 and 700 mm, headroom ≥ 2.0 m, width ≥ 900 mm
Guarding at stairs, balconies and voids
guard height ≥ 900 mm (stairs) and 1100 mm (balconies, voids); no gap > 100 mm
Persons with Disabilities Act 2020; Accessibility Standards
level or ramped entrance (≤ 1:12), door clear width ≥ 800 mm, one accessible WC on the entrance floor
WC, wash basin and shower per bedroom suite or per 5 people; ventilated wet rooms
Planning and site (Physical Planning Act: Physical Planning Act 2010; KCCA approved plan
front, side and rear distances to the boundary from the site plan
Plot coverage and floor area ratio
building footprint / plot area; total floor area / plot area against the zone limits
storeys and ridge height against the zone
spaces against the zone requirement for a dwelling
Documentation for the permit: site plan, floor plans, sections, elevations, roof plan, schedules, signed by a registered architect
every opening scheduled with size, type, fire rating and ironmongery
floors, walls and ceilings per room
every wall the structure relies on marked on the plans; no new openings in them

Water supply (NWSC, BS EN 806): occupants × 150 l/person/day × 2 days of storage → tank size
sum of loading units per branch → pipe diameter; velocity ≤ 2 m/s
static head from the tank base to the outlet ≥ 0.5 bar (5 m), else a booster pump
storage at 60 °C, delivered ≥ 50 °C within 30 s; heater sizing by peak demand
check valves, isolation valve on every branch and fitting
Sanitary fittings and drainage (BS EN 12: fittings per room: WC, basin, shower, sink, with model and connection size
Q = K √(Σ DU), K = 0.5 for dwellings → stack and branch diameters
trap seal ≥ 50 mm, branch gradients 1:40 to 1:80, vent every stack
capacity C = 180 P + 2000 litres, P = population
area from the percolation rate Vp; distance ≥ 15 m from any well
Rainwater (BS EN 12056-3): Q = roof area × rainfall intensity (Kampala 75–100 mm/h) → gutter and downpipe sizes
roof area × annual rainfall × 0.8 runoff; tank for the dry-season demand
Documentation: supply, hot water, waste and soil per floor; isometric of every wet room
manholes, inverts, falls, septic tank and soakaway

Supply and loads (BS 7671, Electricity A: connected load per circuit, diversity → maximum demand in kVA
single or three phase from the maximum demand; meter position
every circuit, device rating, cable and RCD on one diagram
Circuits and protection (BS 7671): Cable sizing: current and voltage drop
Iz ≥ In ≥ Ib with correction factors; voltage drop ≤ 3% lighting, 5% power
Earth fault loop impedance and disconnection
Zs ≤ Zs max for the device (0.4 s final circuits)
30 mA RCD on every socket and bathroom circuit
TT or TN-S; electrode resistance RA × IΔn ≤ 50 V
risk assessment; type 2 SPD at the main board
Lightning, lighting and power: risk R1 against 10⁻⁵; Uganda has high thunder-day counts
living 100–150 lx, kitchen 300 lx, study 300 lx; fittings from the layout
minimum counts per room type; kitchen worktop sockets
Solar PV and backup: daily energy Wh ÷ (peak sun hours 5.0 × 0.75) → array kWp; inverter ≥ peak load
energy for the backed-up loads × days of autonomy ÷ depth of discharge
outlet counts, cable category, network cabinet position

Ventilation: kitchen 60 l/s (or 30 l/s cooker hood), bathroom 15 l/s, WC 6 l/s
Cooling (if fitted): sensible + latent gains per room (W/m²); unit capacity ≥ load
condensate falls to a trapped drain; pipe runs within the unit's limits
Solar hot water: area from the demand and solar fraction; tilt about 15° facing north or south (equator)

Brief and concept: Interior concept approved by the client
mood boards, finishes palette, signed approval
work triangle 4–8 m; clearance ≥ 1000 mm between runs; worktop height 900 mm
Joinery and furniture: elevations, sections and details of kitchen, wardrobes, vanities, feature joinery
board, veneer, hardware and finishes per item
every loose item with supplier, quantity and price
Surface spread of flame of finishes
wall and ceiling linings class 1 (or C-s3,d2) in escape routes

Means of escape (Uganda Fire Brigade req: escape windows (clear opening ≥ 0.33 m², ≥ 450 mm wide, sill ≤ 1100 mm) or a protected stair
stair enclosed or alternative escape; doors onto the stair self-closing where required
60 min for floors and the frame (covers from the structural design)
Detection and first-aid firefighting: Grade D1, Category LD2: smoke alarms in escape routes and living rooms, heat alarm in the kitchen, interlinked
one 2 kg CO₂ and one 6 l foam per floor; fire blanket in the kitchen
cylinders outside, ventilated, isolation valve, leak test
Security: zones, detectors and panel position (client choices)
camera positions covering gate, entrances, perimeter; recorder position

Boundary wall and gate: wind 0.75 kPa on the wall; piers or buttresses at spacing; overturning and sliding of the footing
strip footing for the wall weight; depth below the topsoil
joints in masonry at ≤ 6 m (block) and at changes of height
leaf weight and wind on the posts; post foundation
Driveway and site drainage: Uganda road design manual (soil CBR needed)
layer thicknesses from the subgrade CBR and car loading
Q = C i A for paved and roof areas; channel and soakaway sizes
ground falls ≥ 1:40 away from the building for 3 m; finished floor ≥ 150 mm above ground

Planting: Tree positions against foundations and drains
distance ≥ mature height × factor for the species and soil
Water and light: area × crop factor × reference evapotranspiration; supplied from the harvested rainwater
paths ≥ 5 lx; fittings IP65; on a timer or photocell
Hard and soft areas: soft landscape area / plot area against the zone minimum
